title: Structure-aware DJ transitions
summary: A browser-based DJ assistant trained on song structure. It maps verses and choruses, recommends the next track and cue points, and mixes the handoff live.
lead: Our DJ assistant can leave one song at the end of a chorus and enter the next at the start of a verse. A CNN and bidirectional LSTM map the arrangement of each track. Claude uses those maps to recommend a transition the DJ can hear and adjust in the browser.

media.alt: Two translucent records in turquoise and pink with yellow cue markers, an illustration of a handoff between tracks.
media.thumbnailAlt: Two color-coded records marked for a transition
media.caption: Example transition plan. A low-pass sweep connects the outgoing chorus to the incoming track.
